email.subject: Medicare Open Enrollment starts October 15
email.body:
Open Enrollment runs October 15 to December 7, 2026. Changes take effect January 1, 2027.

If you have Original Medicare and a Medicare Supplement (Medigap) policy, your supplement is not affected by Open Enrollment, but this is a good time to compare Part D drug plans. Your drug plan's Annual Notice of Change should have arrived by September 30.

Free, unbiased counseling is available through your State Health Insurance Assistance Program. In New York, this is HIICAP.

messages.body: Mr. Zhang, I have a fever, I cannot come today, Monday. Very sorry.
Rest well, Fang. See you Wednesday.
Verado: Your package for LIN Z (order 7731-0942) is out for delivery today.
Verado: Delivered. Left at front door.
Wei, a box from Verado was sitting on your stoop. I took it in so it doesn't sit in the sun. I'll bring it over after dinner.
Thank you Grace. It is Lin's medicine. We were in the back and didn't hear the bell.
No problem. I'm going to Golden Harvest tomorrow, need anything?
Soft tofu and a bag of oranges if it's no trouble. I will pay you back.
Left them by your door. $6.48, pay me whenever.
Ken, I can make the 27th.
Great! Frank will be happy. I'll put you down. Jade Palace, 12 noon.
How is Lin doing?
Some good days. Mornings are slow. Thank you for asking.
We arrive Friday Oct 16 and stay three nights, can't wait to see Mom!
Dad, I sent the $435 Zelle on Saturday, did it come?
Yes it came. Thank you.
by the time we get the bags and a car from JFK we'll be in Flushing around 10 pm
Hi Ye Ye! Can you send me Nai Nai's pork and chive dumpling recipe? I want to make them for my dorm potluck next weekend.
Your Nai Nai never measures. I will ask her and write it down.

1 lb ground pork, not too lean. 1 bunch Chinese chives chopped fine. 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp Shaoxing wine, a little grated ginger, white pepper. Stir in 3 tbsp water in one direction. Round thin wrappers from Golden Harvest.
THANK YOU. Tell Nai Nai I love her. I'm coming with Dad on the 18th for dinner!
Hong, Parkside Inn is changed to Oct 15 to Oct 22. Same room, ground floor. Confirmation PKF-778104.
Thank you Wei!! Who picks me at LGA? I can take taxi.
Mei will pick you up. She will wait at arrivals, Terminal B.
OK. Lin can talk on phone today?
Call after 4. She is better in the afternoon after the 3 pm pill.
Mr. Zhang, Monday Oct 12 I cannot come, my son is moving apartment and I have to watch the baby. I will tell Rosa.
OK Fang. I will ask Mei to come.
Thank you. Don't forget flu shots today 1:30.
Mei, Fang is off Monday Oct 12. Can you come 8 to 1?
Yes. Lucas has no school that day anyway, I'll bring him. We'll be there 7:45.
Good. The 11 am pill is in the blue pill box on the counter, Monday slot. 11 exactly.
I know Dad. I'll set an alarm.
Should I make lunch or will you?
Fang usually makes congee with chicken. Lunch after 11:30, not together with the pill.
Tresswell #112: 1 prescription ready for WEI Z. Pick up by 10/12.
Tresswell #112: Thank you for picking up your prescription today.
Where are you
At Golden Harvest. Back in 20 minutes. Did you take the 3 o'clock?
Yes. Buy pears
OK. Pears and the soft buns.
Booked Jade Garden Seafood for Sunday 10/18, 5:30, table for 9, near the door so Mom doesn't have to walk far.
Good. 5:30 means she eats after the 3 pm pill and is home before 7. I will pay.
Dad, no. David and I already said we're splitting it. You paid for Auntie Hong's hotel in March.
Hong paid me back for March.
Still no. Let us do this one.
Good morning Mr. Zhang, bus is slow on Kissena Blvd, I will be there 8:15. Sorry.
OK no problem. Lin had her 7 am pill already. Breakfast when you come.
I'm here, coming up the steps.
Hi Wei, are you and Lin coming on the 13th? I'm counting chairs for the exercise group.
Yes, both of us. We have to leave by 2:30, Lin's pill is at 3.
Perfect. Could you bring the folding walker brochure you mentioned? Joyce asked about it.
Yes, I will bring it.
Ming, can you put a grab bar in the bathroom next to the toilet? And check the one in the shower, it is a little loose.
Yes Mr. Zhang. Friday Oct 9 at 2 pm ok? I bring a 24 inch stainless bar. $180 for both jobs including the bar.
2 pm is good. Cash OK?
Cash is fine. If I can't find the stud behind the tile it takes a little longer.
Wexley Medical Group: WEI has an appt with Dr. Okafor on Thu 10/22 at 9:15 AM. Reply C to confirm, R to reschedule.
C
Thank you. Your appointment is confirmed.
Mr. Zhang, reminder to sign the 8879 and the NY form by Tuesday 10/13. The e-sign link expires 10/14.
Can I come to the office Friday 10 am? Fang is with Lin then.
10 am Friday is fine, but Lin has to sign too.
Lin can't come. I will do the e-sign link with her at home tonight.
That works. Then no need to come in.
Dad, cleared it with work, I'm off on the 20th. I'll be at the house 9:45. Still 10:30 at Wexley, 4th floor?
Yes 10:30, 4th floor. Mom's 11 am pill will be in the small case, I will give it to you.
Got it. Park in the garage on 39th Ave?
Yes, the Wexley lot is always full. They validate 2 hours at the front desk.
Mei, Helen and I are doing a video call for Mom's birthday on Sunday Oct 11
11 am pill done at 11:00. She ate half the oatmeal and the banana at 8:30.
We walk to the corner and back after lunch if no rain. Laundry is in the dryer.
Thank you. Ming the handyman comes Friday at 2 for the grab bar, after you leave. Please move the towels off the rack Friday morning.
OK I will.
Briarwood Dental Arts: Reminder for LIN, Wed 10/14 at 1:45 PM. Reply Y to confirm.
Y. Can we be done by 3? She has medication at 3.
Hi Mr. Zhang, this is Tanya at the front desk. Cleaning and exam take about an hour, you should be out by 2:50. You're welcome to give her the medication here, we'll have water ready.
Hi Mr. Zhang, noted: no aide on 10/12. For Thursday 10/29, Fang can do 8 to 1. Shall I put it on the schedule?
Yes please. Can you bill it on its own line? My daughter Helen pays for that day.
Yes, it will be a separate line on the October invoice. All set.
Fall lunch: Tue Oct 27, 12 noon, Jade Palace on 37th Ave, Flushing. $35 each, pay at the table. Reply here so I can give the restaurant a number.
I'm in. Driving up from Staten Island, God help me on the BQE.
Count me in. Wei
In. Can we not sit by the kitchen door this year
Already asked for the back room. 11 so far.
Dr. Feinberg's office moved Mom's appointment from Oct 13 to Tuesday Oct 20, 10:30 am.
I can take her on the 20th. I'll take the day off.
I can do it if David can't, just tell me by Friday.
Thanks David. Can someone ask Dr. Feinberg about the mornings? Mom said the 7 am pill takes longer to kick in now.
It is on my list for Dr. Feinberg.
Harmony invoice for September: 12 visits, 60 hours, $1,740. Fang was off Labor Day.
Sent my $870.
I'll send $435 Saturday.
Thank you both. I pay the other $435.
And I'm on Monday the 12th since Fang is off.
Dad, what size slippers does Mom wear now? I'm bringing the ones with backs that don't slip.
Size 7. With a back, yes. The old ones she walks right out of.
Got it. Anything you need from Seattle?
Just you. And the smoked salmon your mother likes.
David, Wexley sent a bill for $140.20 for my September visit. I am waiting for the Plan G EOB before I pay. Same as August.
Makes sense. The Medicare notice says that's your deductible?
Yes. $142.80 in August plus $140.20 now is the $283. After this Plan G covers the rest of the year.
Good. When is it due?
October 28. The EOB usually comes 2 to 3 weeks after Medicare.
Dinner for Auntie Hong: Sunday 10/18, 5:30 at Jade Garden Seafood. Table for 9. David and I are splitting the bill. Dad, you are NOT paying.
Agreed. Karen and Annie are coming.
OK, OK. We will pick up Hong at the Parkside Inn at 5:10 on the way.
Reminder: Tue 10/13, 1:00-2:30, Bowne Street Community Church. Speaker on swallowing safety. No peanuts please.
Will the chair exercise group run? My husband likes it.
Yes, next room, two volunteers.
Question: our mail-order pharmacy was late in August and we needed a 10-day bridge supply from Tresswell. How do others avoid this?
Tresswell on Main St did same day for us too. Ask for Mr. Patel, he knows the Parkinson's meds.
Check the label for refills left. When it says 0, call the neurologist a month ahead. Verado won't ship without a new script.
Mr. Zhang, may I have Friday Oct 16 off? My grandson's school ceremony. I will come Monday as usual.

notes.title: Paying doctor bills
notes.body:
My rule: don't pay a doctor's bill until the Plan G explanation of benefits for it has come.
Order: doctor bills Medicare, Medicare Summary Notice, Medicare sends it to Plan G by itself, Plan G EOB, then the doctor's bill is right.
Last year Wexley billed me $96 that Plan G paid later, and it took 3 months to get the refund.
Check: EOB 'your responsibility' = bill amount. If not the same, call Wexley billing (718) 555-0140 option 3 before paying.
Part B deductible 2026: $283. Plan G does not pay that part.

turns.text: Hong Li is coming Oct 14 to 22. Find a hotel close to us in Flushing with a ground floor room.

The Parkside Inn on Northern Blvd is about 1.2 miles from the house, and Hong stayed there in March. Their renovated ground floor rooms have walk-in showers. For those dates it's $189 a night Sunday to Thursday and $209 Friday and Saturday. Their fall newsletter also mentions a 10% Neighbor Rate for relatives of local residents staying 5 nights or more.
Book it. Put the deposit on my Visa, she pays the rest.

Booked: Parkside Inn, confirmation PKF-778104, guest Hong Li, Oct 14 to 22 (8 nights), ground floor queen with walk-in shower. The $189 first-night deposit is on your Visa ending 4417 and Hong pays the balance at check-in. The Neighbor Rate can't be added online, so she should ask for it at the front desk.
Harmony invoice was $1,885 for August. What's everyone's share?
With your split (David half, Helen a quarter, you a quarter): David $942.50, Helen $471.25, you $471.25. That's 13 visits of 5 hours at $29 an hour, every Mon/Wed/Fri in August.
And October, if Fang is off the 12th?

October has 13 Mon/Wed/Fri days. Without the 12th that's 12 visits of 5 hours = 60 hours, or $1,740.00. Split: David $870.00, Helen $435.00, you $435.00. Adding Thursday the 29th would be 5 more hours, $145.00.
Helen pays the 29th herself.
Got it. Helen's October total would be $435.00 + $145.00 = $580.00. I've added that to your Fang cost split note.

Dr. Feinberg's office called today about the new medicine she is adding for Lin. The drug plan has to approve it first. When the drug plan approves it, have it filled through the plan's mail order, Verado Home Delivery, not Tresswell: it is $0 there for 90 days. Verado already has Lin's other prescription on file. And let Fang know how she is to give it, and that Dr. Feinberg says it can turn Lin's urine dark orange-brown; that is harmless, so Fang is not to be alarmed.

Got it. Once the drug plan approves it, it goes to Verado Home Delivery, not Tresswell, where it's $0 for 90 days. And Fang is to hear how to give it, and that the dark orange-brown urine Dr. Feinberg mentioned is harmless and nothing to be alarmed about.
Wexley sent a bill for $140.20 for my Sept 24 visit, due Oct 28. No Plan G EOB yet. Should I pay it now?

Your rule is to wait for the Plan G EOB before paying a doctor's bill. The Medicare Summary Notice from Oct 1 lists $140.20 for the 9/24 visit as Part B deductible. With the $142.80 from August that makes the full $283, so the amount looks right, and Plan G doesn't pay the deductible. The bill isn't due until Oct 28, and in August the EOB came about four weeks after the visit, so there's time to wait.
OK. Remind me to look for the EOB around the 20th.
Done. I'll remind you Tuesday, Oct 20 at 4 pm, after Lin's Dr. Feinberg visit, to check for the Hartwell Mutual EOB for the 9/24 Wexley visit.
Lin has the dentist Oct 14 at 1:45 and Dr. Feinberg Oct 20 at 10:30. How do I handle her pills those days?

Her doses are 7 am, 11 am, 3 pm and 7 pm, and Dr. Feinberg wants them exact.

Oct 14, dentist: the 11 am dose is at home as usual with Fang. The visit takes about an hour, so you should be out around 2:50. Bring the 3 pm tablet and water in case it runs late.

Oct 20, Dr. Feinberg: the 11 am dose falls during the visit. Bring it in the small case and give it at 11 even if you're in the exam room. David picks you up at 9:45, so the 7 am dose and breakfast stay the same.
And lunch on the 20th?
Since she takes the pill 30 minutes before meals, lunch at 11:30 or later. If the visit runs long, keep crackers or fruit in the car and have a proper lunch at home. Save the meat for dinner.
